newsitem.title: UK: Turkey to issue 500 bln ITL 5-year bond - dealers.
newsitem.headline: Turkey to issue 500 bln ITL 5-year bond - dealers.

text.p: Turkey's expected Italian lira Eurobond was likely to be a 500 billion lire five-year issue, syndicate managers said on Tuesday.
"Turkey will launch a 500 billion lire five-year deal," said a syndicate manager at a European bank.
Another trader said: "The maturity on Turkey's deal will not be longer than five years."
On Monday, bankers in Istanbul said Turkey had mandated Chase to lead manage a debut lira Eurobond in late February or early March. Officials at Chase in London declined to comment.
